_comment: Rows for voice_voicemails_list, newest first. audio_presign_ok is a fixture-only helper the tools strip before serving: vm_1 mints a presigned audio_url (unless audio_urls === 'false'); vm_2 models the swallowed-presign trap - has_audio stays true while audio_url comes back null because per-key presign errors are swallowed to null (registered description of voice_voicemails_list). vm_2's underlying call row (2026-08-26) predates the 24h diagnostic window calls.json holds, which is why calls.json shows one voicemail-disposition row while this inbox holds two. Field split per the description: a raw transcript lives in transcript_text with summary null; an AI summary lives in summary with transcript_text null; the legacy transcript field is transcript_text falling back to summary.

voicemails.summary: Caller asking whether their fixture order shipped; wants a call back before end of day.

voicemails.transcript_text: Hi, this is Marla from Caldwell Interiors, I left a message earlier this week about the pendant order and have not heard back, please call me at 972-555-0244.
